latest.notes: Fluid top of hour. If an hour's content lands within a minute of the top, the scheduler no longer crams a filler song into the final seconds and the player no longer holds for the exact HH:00 — the hour floats and the next hour starts a touch early. Applies to both log generation and the live now-playing log. Gaps larger than a minute still fill with music; hours more than a minute short still top up.
